-- 1 sola consulta: upsert del lead + insert del mensaje deduplicado por wamid.
-- Devuelve la etapa actual del bot para decidir qué responder.
WITH lead AS (
  INSERT INTO public.leads (phone, phone_number_id, name, source, temp, status, stage,
                            last_message, last_message_time)
  VALUES ($1, $7, NULLIF($2, ''), 'whatsapp', 'caliente', 'nuevo', 'lead',
          $3, to_timestamp($5::bigint))
  ON CONFLICT (phone, phone_number_id) DO UPDATE SET
    name              = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name, leads.name),
    -- Solo si es más reciente (Meta puede reintentar o desordenar webhooks).
    last_message      = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.last_message_time >= COALESCE(leads.last_message_time, '-infinity')
                             THEN EXCLUDED.last_message ELSE leads.last_message END,
    last_message_time = GREATEST(leads.last_message_time, EXCLUDED.last_message_time)
  RETURNING id, bot_stage
), msg AS (
  INSERT INTO public.messages (lead_id, phone, phone_number_id, sender, text, time, wa_message_id, msg_type)
  SELECT id, $1, $7, 'cliente', $3, to_timestamp($5::bigint), $4, $6
  FROM lead
  ON CONFLICT (wa_message_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  lead.id                    AS lead_id,
  $1::text                   AS phone,
  $7::text                   AS phone_number_id,
  lead.bot_stage             AS bot_stage,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM msg) AS mensaje_nuevo,
  -- Configuración de la agencia (si la línea no está registrada, textos por defecto).
  COALESCE(wl.agencia, '')       AS agencia,
  COALESCE(wl.bienvenida, '')    AS bienvenida,
  COALESCE(wl.info_terrenos, '') AS info_terrenos,
  COALESCE(wl.bot_activo, true)  AS bot_activo
FROM lead
LEFT JOIN public.whatsapp_lineas wl ON wl.phone_number_id = $7;

-- Cambia la etapa solo si sigue siendo la que leímos. Si llegan 2 mensajes
-- a la vez, solo uno gana y el cliente recibe una sola respuesta.
WITH u AS (
  UPDATE public.leads
  SET    bot_stage       = $2,
         welcome_sent_at = COALESCE(welcome_sent_at, NOW())
  WHERE  id = $1
    AND  bot_stage IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF($3, '')
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM u) AS responder;
